permissions._classification: Tracked allowlist, classified by reversibility (board-converged shape, 2026-08-10). allow = read-only + one-commit-reversible writes inside the repo. deny = the irreversible tail; deny prefix-matches, which is why blanket 'git -C *' is deliberately ABSENT from allow — it would carry irreversible verbs past every deny prefix. Subagents (whose cwd resets between calls) use 'bash tools/wt.sh <worktree> <verbs>', which refuses the irreversible tail in code.
